findings.title: Reflected XSS in search endpoint
findings.description: User-supplied query is reflected unescaped in the HTML response, allowing arbitrary JavaScript execution in the victim's browser.
findings.remediationNotes: HTML-encode all user-controlled output and enforce a strict Content-Security-Policy.

findings.title: SQL injection in login form
findings.description: The username field is interpolated directly into a SQL query without parameterization, permitting authentication bypass.
findings.evidence: Payload ' OR '1'='1 returned HTTP 200 with session cookie
findings.remediationNotes: Use parameterized queries/prepared statements throughout the authentication layer.
